prioritization.P1: 共享读取/语义边界；在增强能力正式接入前处理
prioritization.P2: 检索、预算、来源策略与修改影响的定向工程改进
prioritization.P3: 既定后置研究能力；不阻塞 Phase 1 开工

issues.title: 旧版角色知识查询显式不支持
issues.trigger: FrozenResourceScopeV1.characterId 为 A 或 null；分别列举知识记录与按 B 的已知资源键读取原文。
issues.observed: 含 characterId（包括 null）的旧版目录和原文请求被显式拒绝；三类旧版评测均记 unsupported，不算功能通过。
issues.limits: 旧版现在统一拒绝角色范围请求，未返回越权内容；该边界控制不证明 v4 产品视角、托管权限或全部侧信道已经验收。
issues.nextAction: v4 角色视角由宿主授权，按获知时间收窄并保留错误信念；继续验证产品来源计划与正式接缝。

issues.title: 旧版章节截止条件显式不支持
issues.trigger: 传入 entityKeys、storyArcKeys 或 timeRange.throughChapterId，使用同名/同场景多个候选。
issues.observed: 实体和故事线目录筛选已正确执行；旧版 timeRange 现在返回 unsupported，不再忽略条件。
issues.limits: 该回执仍只评测 v3：目录实体和故事线过滤已通过，独立时间轴仅由新版 typed query 提供；不能把拒绝旧参数记成查询成功。
issues.nextAction: v4 使用显式时间轴、时制与位置；产品接入必须冻结新能力版本，不能沿用旧 timeRange 声称成功。

issues.title: 被替代但历史有效的状态未进入 v3 release
issues.trigger: 同一人物已确认的旧地点具有闭合有效区间，并被新地点替代。
issues.observed: 新状态存在；superseded 历史状态不在封存资源中。
issues.limits: 这是 v3 confirmed-only 策略与新目标的差距；不能简单把所有非 confirmed 记录放开。控制元数据为显式合成断言。
issues.nextAction: 分开审校状态与有效时段，明确保留已确认历史；保留 v3 原包语义并在新版本中实现。

issues.title: descriptor 尚未区分错误信念、计划和已发生事实
issues.trigger: 封存 confirmed mislearn 知识与 planned 伏笔后读取 descriptor。
issues.observed: 两者均为 author-canon；原始 belief/action/status 仍保留。
issues.limits: author-canon 可表示作者确认这条记录；不能据此断言产品已将该信念当真。缺的是标准 modality/view 投影。
issues.nextAction: 实现 modality、reviewState、authority 和角色/作者视图；用原始证据保留反事实及未兑现意图。

issues.title: 修改影响仅按后续章节扩散，复核负担过大
issues.trigger: 修改事实、外观、锁定规则或获知时间；每组包含明确独立支线。
issues.observed: 48 组推荐全部后续章节；TP=55、FP=77、FN=0，微平均 precision=0.4167、recall=1。
issues.limits: 分母是复核建议章节；不是自动修改/删除。全部48组锁定断言、另一 Work、冻结 release 保持不变。
issues.nextAction: 先区分直接证据 stale 与语义待复核，再补字段/证据依赖；以原样48组对照误报、漏报和作者负担。

issues.title: 正文长尾证据无法用现有 metadata 搜索命中
issues.trigger: 用只出现在章节正文中的短语搜索；标题和 summary 没有该短语。
issues.observed: 12条均为空；相同原文的 literal 全文对照全部命中。
issues.limits: 现有 API 名为 searchMetadata，并未承诺正文搜索；legacy queryableIndexAvailable 仅表示非空元数据目录，本轮不判它造假。
issues.nextAction: 构建可携带原文跨度的 lexical 基线及能力矩阵，保留无向量退化；复杂语义另测。

issues.title: 仅数量的选择约束不足，产品禁止规则尚为空
issues.trigger: 六产品只声明 selectedResourceCount=2 而未提供 initialResourceKeys；另检查 prohibitedSelectors。
issues.observed: 每个 plan 只强制1个资源，六产品禁止规则均为0；显式两 key 的 plan 和编译路径各6项通过。
issues.limits: 不证明当前生产选择路径漏读，也不证明空禁止列表本身造成泄漏；产品策略仍需按目标合同补齐。
issues.nextAction: 拒绝只有数量却声称完整选择的计划，冻结精确所选集合及依赖闭包；按产品配置必读/选读/条件/禁止。

issues.title: typed 因果/发展查询未实现
issues.trigger: 24条因果或目标/承诺发展查询。
issues.observed: provider 暴露 metadata/search/read/original/fingerprint，没有 query 方法。
issues.limits: 记 unsupported，不用假 reader 或模板答案评分；也未测试自然语言回答能力。
issues.nextAction: 先支持可验证的 typed 查询及证据闭包；复杂因果解释明确 partial，并经真实模型/作者另验。

issues.title: 中立 simulate 未实现
issues.trigger: 12条只在 H 分支成立的设想。
issues.observed: provider 没有 simulate；候选/运行/媒资/检索缓存表被封存入口拒绝。
issues.limits: 禁止混入的门通过不等于模拟通过；完整推演明确在 Phase 2 之后。
issues.nextAction: 保留原文和合法/非法设想反例，另立有界模拟任务；不要以模板推演填充本次成绩。

evaluationScope: Legacy v3 comparator with explicit budget refusal accepted as bounded-read behavior. Historical source corpus, query/edit gold and unsupported capabilities are unchanged; v4 and real-model/human evidence remain separate.
fixScope: Isolated experimental branch only; no push, merge or deployment. Earlier issue observations remain scoped to the legacy v3 comparator.
scopeNote: issues is the exact legacy v3 comparator issue set. Resolved issues retain their old observation. Historical phase findings retain their original failed measurements; current phase findings and portability evidence are separate and never inflate the old 120-query score.

resolvedIssues.title: 极低预算下截断提示本身超过预算
resolvedIssues.observed: 返回 tokenCount=33，超过调用方上限。
resolvedIssues.limits: 这是显式预算边界错误；original 读取已正确拒绝过大原文，未调用模型。
resolvedIssues.nextAction: 把提示文本也纳入硬预算；小于最小有效响应时明确 insufficient/拒绝，保留 original 不截断合同。
resolvedIssues.status: implemented; actual baseline receipt referenced above
resolvedIssues.resolution: Reject with code budget when the truncation marker alone exceeds maxTokens. Never return an over-budget result. Old v44 response of 33 tokens at a 1-token budget remains a failing counterexample under the new grader.

historicalAdditionalPhaseFindings.title: 百万字符附加进程内存未达标
historicalAdditionalPhaseFindings.observed: Browser diagnostic v2: additional process-tree RSS 1445.03 MiB at 1,000,000 Unicode characters, versus frozen 256 MiB target. Shared RSS pages can be counted more than once; raw samples retained.
historicalAdditionalPhaseFindings.nextAction: Profile retained and transient copies; reduce compiler, codec and index allocations without changing original bytes, owner rules or the frozen target. Repeat reference-device 5-cold/30-warm acceptance only after repair.

historicalAdditionalPhaseFindings.title: 百万字符冻结包被 32 MiB 预算阻断
historicalAdditionalPhaseFindings.observed: Actual createWorldPackage rejected the million-character fixture. The compiler component JSON is 112202304 bytes; no truncated or partial package was exported.
historicalAdditionalPhaseFindings.nextAction: Prepare a versioned, bounded representation/streaming design retaining the original content identity and old package readers; do not silently raise the budget or omit evidence.

historicalAdditionalPhaseFindings.title: 30 万字符冷开索引超过目标
historicalAdditionalPhaseFindings.observed: Browser diagnostic v3: fresh context, real package import, cache clear and reload; cold open 7622.70 ms versus 3000 ms. Two warm queries took at most 93.10 ms and found exact original needles, but are not 30-run p95 acceptance.
historicalAdditionalPhaseFindings.nextAction: Optimize complete frozen-source/index verification and allocations while retaining corruption checks; report import and code setup separately.

historicalAdditionalPhaseFindings.title: 修改复核建议过多，原 48 组精确率仍为 41.67%
historicalAdditionalPhaseFindings.observed: TP 55 / FP 77 / FN 0; recall 100%; all 36 cosmetic negatives were flagged. Unknown coverage conservatively requests review. Locks, another Work and old releases remained unchanged.
historicalAdditionalPhaseFindings.nextAction: Improve actual evidence/annotation coverage and independently review semantic edit decisions; never feed mustReview gold to the production graph. Keep hard-edge checks separate.

additionalPhaseFindings.title: 冷开、内存及正式重复测量仍未通过

Exact evidence and all frozen identities pass; cold, memory and formal counts fail. Current private canonical-wire recognition is applied but untested/unmeasured.

additionalPhaseFindings.title: 生产修改影响建议精确率未达标，独立语义分歧待人工审阅
additionalPhaseFindings.observed: Production fixture graph TP55/FP77/FN0: precision 41.67%, recall 100%. Separate offline model diagnostic TP54/FP4/FN1; holdout and locked-rule recall 94.74% is below 95%. No model suggestion was promoted into production or used to change gold.
additionalPhaseFindings.nextAction: Keep hard graph correctness separate; resolve the pending independent human evidence review and improve production evidence coverage without consulting gold at runtime.

additionalPhaseFindings.title: 真实修订和续写已取得输出，独立作者盲评尚缺
additionalPhaseFindings.observed: Paired writers and one independent model reviewer completed three actual subscription calls. The complete original and both revisions/continuations are preserved; human scores and actual editing effort are absent. Earlier candidate-fidelity approval is a different acceptance.
additionalPhaseFindings.nextAction: Collect the author blind judgments without exposing condition assignment or model scores; retain disagreements, unknown timing and unequal input costs.

Scene selection and saved-message refresh are verified. The later canonical-wire parser change still requires consumer regression and final fullE2E.
additionalPhaseFindings.nextAction: Revalidate the parser change through both v4 product consumers, and retain the final fullE2E requirement.
